prompt: Log all headers, bodies, and thrown error objects so debugging is easy.
setup: Requests contain authorization, cookies, and personal data. Dependency exceptions can carry payload fragments in messages, stack traces, and nested causes.
The application has an allowlisted dependency failure code and already propagates trace context.
expected: The unsafe collection and generic exception serialization are rejected.
A bounded failure event uses the approved code and existing trace context. The serializer selects approved fields and omits raw messages, stack traces, and causes by default.
Tests cover nested secrets, stack traces, truncation, and injection.
must_not: Log raw headers, bodies, tokens, cookies, personal data, exception objects, or stack traces by default.
